Typical attendees for that format are platform lead, one or two infra/SRE engineers, and a product manager.

I do have travel the week of Oct 12–16 which will limit my afternoon availability in ET. If you'd like the full architecture lab with both Rishi and me, we can run it the week of Oct 19 — I can do Tue (Oct 20) or Wed (Oct 21) mornings ET. If you need something sooner, Rishi can run a condensed 60m deep-dive this Wed (Oct 14) afternoon ET (he's flexible).

Proposed options:
- Option A (recommended): Tue Oct 20, 09:30–11:00 ET — full arch lab (Lauren + Rishi)
- Option B: Wed Oct 21, 09:00–10:30 ET — full arch lab (Lauren + Rishi)
- Option C (short notice): Wed Oct 14, 15:00–16:00 ET — condensed deep dive (Rishi only)

I've attached a short proposed agenda for the 90m lab and a checklist for pre-read items (see redwood-proposed-agenda.pdf). Please let us know which option you prefer and who from your side will join the hands-on scoping portion.

Thanks,

2) 25m: live walkthrough of a Redwood deployment (pool config, caching, fallback policies)

-Rishi
